I couldn't get the obedience trial list for New York in May. The search never ran, so I have no events to report.

- **Date range:** Today is 2026-11-07, so I took "May" to mean May 2027 and set the range to 05/01/2027–05/31/2027.
- **State:** New York (NY) is selected on the Event Search form.
- **What blocked it:** The form requires at least one event type, and the page still says "Choose at least one event type." The three tiles (Conformation, Companion, Performance) have no clickable handles in my browser tool, so I couldn't click Companion Events directly.
- **What I tried:** I used keyboard Tab and Enter to toggle tiles instead. I can't tell which tiles that actually selected, and Retrieve Events still returned nothing.

You can finish it in the open Event Search tab (webapps.akc.org/event-search):
1. Click **Companion Events**, which is where obedience trials are listed.
2. Check that State is NY and the dates are 05/01/2027 to 05/31/2027.
3. Click **Retrieve Events**.

If you tell me the tile is selected, I can read the results and pull out the obedience trials. If you meant a different May, give me the year and I'll redo the dates.
